reviews.text: Using a toner feels refreshing, like a clean splash of balance for your skin. It sweeps away leftover impurities, tightens pores, and preps your face to better absorb serums and creams. People love it because it makes skin feel fresh, hydrated, and perfectly ready for the next step in their routine. ✨
reviews.zh: 用爽膚水嘅感覺好清爽，好似清新地潑一下，令皮膚回復平衡咁。佢可以清除殘餘污垢、收緊毛孔，同埋幫皮膚做好準備，令之後嘅精華同面霜吸收得更好。大家都好鍾意，因為用完皮膚感覺清爽、水潤，而且為下一步護膚做好咗準備。✨

reviews.text: it does nothing for my skin, but it smells nice~ I think I will only buy this product for the scent:)
reviews.zh: 對我嘅皮膚冇乜效果，但係好好聞～我諗我淨係會為咗個香味先買呢款產品:)

reviews.text:
amazing toner for sensitive skin. i have very sensitive skin, and this one doesn't burn and neither turns my skin red.
 it doesn't have a strong smell, which i appreciate, its smell more like herbal tea. really refreshing and moisturizing.
reviews.zh:
超好用嘅化妝水，適合敏感肌。我嘅皮膚好敏感，呢款用落唔會刺痛，皮膚亦唔會變紅。
佢嘅味道唔會好濃，我好欣賞呢點，聞落更似花草茶。非常清爽，又補濕。

reviews.text:
I love this cleansing toner. It makes my skin feel good and it doesn't strip the skin of any moisture. When I'm having a dry skin problem, I mix this in with my cleanser. I use one of the foaming devices that you put face wash and water into and pump it into bubbles. Put this toner in with it and it works so well. It's become an important part of my skin wash routine, especially now that it's winter. Completely stops your skin from feeling dry and reinforces your natural skin barrier.

 It's suitable for skin at any age as it's both gentle and sooth. Great ingredients and it's from a trustworthy and reputable brand. I love all the products from this line, especially the fresh herb origin serum, which is my HG. Products from the line works so well together to make healthy, naturally beautiful dewy skin that feels moisturised and calm.

For reference, I have highly sensitive acne prone skin and this has never stressed my skin out. Love it, will buy again.
reviews.zh:
我好鍾意呢款潔面化妝水。用落感覺好舒服，而且唔會奪走皮膚嘅水分。皮膚乾燥嘅時候，我會將佢同潔面產品混合使用。我用一個起泡器，將潔面產品同水放入去撳成泡沫，再加入呢款化妝水，效果好好。尤其係而家天氣凍，佢已經成為我洗面程序入面嘅重要一環。完全唔會令皮膚覺得乾，仲有助加強皮膚天然屏障。

佢啱任何年齡嘅皮膚用，因為溫和又舒緩。成分好好，而且係來自信得過、有信譽嘅品牌。我好鍾意呢個系列嘅所有產品，特別係 Fresh Herb Origin 精華，係我嘅 HG（最愛）。呢個系列嘅產品一齊用效果好好，令皮膚健康、自然水潤有光澤，感覺保濕又平靜。

補充一點，我嘅皮膚好容易敏感長痘，但呢款產品從來冇令我皮膚不安。好鍾意，會再買。

reviews.text: Der Toner hat einen sehr angenehmen, leichten Geruch, für mich persönlich super geeignet da ich keine stark durftende kosmetik Verträge. Die Haut ist nach dem Toner weich und strahlt. Keine Irritationen zu spüren.
reviews.zh: 呢款化妝水有非常舒服、清淡嘅香味，對我個人嚟講好啱，因為我唔太能夠接受香味好濃嘅化妝品。用完之後，皮膚變得柔軟，亦好有光澤。完全冇感到刺激。

reviews.text: I love that this toner has calendula and it feels so nice on my skin! I alternate this with the Innisfree Bijia trouble skin toner. When my skin is feeling more irritated and red, I reach for this Nacific one because it gently calms my skin.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款化妝水含金盞花，用落皮膚好舒服！我會同 Innisfree Bijia 痘痘肌化妝水交替使用。當皮膚比較刺激、紅紅地嘅時候，我就會揀呢款 Nacific，因為佢可以溫和咁舒緩皮膚。

reviews.text: This will probably be forever my favourite toner! Will 100% be repurchasing and keeping a back up even if I try other toners. Its so instantly hydrating plus candula is great for fungal acne and oily/acne prone skin. But the formula is so hydrating that I would also recommend for dry and dehydrated skin! Do yourself a favourite and GET IT!
reviews.zh: 呢款大概會係我永遠嘅最愛化妝水！就算試其他化妝水，我都一定會再買，仲會留一支做後備。佢即時就好補濕，而且金盞花對真菌性痘痘同油性／易長痘嘅皮膚都好有幫助。不過配方補濕力好強，我都推薦乾性同脫水嘅皮膚用！幫自己一個忙，快啲入手！

reviews.text: Me ha fascinado este tónico, es muy ligero sin dejar una sensación extraña sobre la piel, además, se absorbe bastante rápido, lo utilizo junto al serum de la misma línea pero podría funcionar solo.
reviews.zh: 呢款化妝水令我好著迷，質地好輕，搽完冇奇怪嘅黏膩感，而且吸收得好快。我會同同系列嘅精華一齊用，不過單用都應該得。
